Bootstrapping

Lina Marcinczyk

2026-11-12

Simulated datasets

n_samp = 250

sim_df_const = 
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(n_samp, 1, 1),
    error = rnorm(n_samp, 0, 1), 
    y = 2 + 3 * x + error
  )

sim_df_nonconst = 
  sim_df_const |> 
  mutate(
    error = error * .75 * x,
    y = 2 + 3 * x + error
  )

Plotting

sim_df_const |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth()
## `geom_smooth()` using method = 'loess' and formula = 'y ~ x'

sim_df_nonconst |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Fit the regressions

 sim_df_const |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
term estimate std.error statistic p.value
(Intercept) 1.977 0.098 20.157 0
x 3.045 0.070 43.537 0 
 sim_df_nonconst |> 
  lm(y ~ x, data = _) |> 
  broom::tidy() |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
term estimate std.error statistic p.value
(Intercept) 1.934 0.105 18.456 0
x 3.112 0.075 41.661 0

Draw a bootstrap sample

always need a function

draw_boot_sample = function(df) {
  
  sample_frac(df, replace = TRUE)
  
}

Does it work

sim_df_nonconst |> 
  draw_boot_sample() |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Draw a bunch of samples and analyze

boot_straps =
  tibble(strap_number = 1:1000) |>
  mutate(
    strap_sample = map(strap_number,
                       \(i) draw_boot_sample(sim_df_nonconst)),
    model_fit = map(strap_sample, \(df) lm(y ~ x, data = df)),
    results = map(model_fit, broom::tidy)
  ) |>
  unnest(results)

Did it work

boot_straps |> 
  group_by(term) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_est = mean(estimate), 
    se_est = sd(estimate)
  )
## # A tibble: 2 × 3
##   term        mean_est se_est
##   <chr>          <dbl>  <dbl>
## 1 (Intercept)     1.93 0.0747
## 2 x               3.11 0.101

Look at the results more

boot_straps |> 
  select(strap_number, strap_sample) |> 
  unnest(strap_sample) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, group = strap_number)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, alpha = .3) +
  geom_point(data = sim_df_nonconst, aes(group = NULL), alpha = .6)
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

Quick notes

boots =
  sim_df_nonconst |> 
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 1000)

Airbnb

data("nyc_airbnb")

nyc_airbnb =
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location / 2) |> 
  rename(
    borough = neighbourhood_group,
    neighborhood = neighbourhood) |> 
  filter(borough != "Staten Island") |> 
  drop_na(price, stars) |> 
  select(price, stars, borough, neighborhood, room_type)

Looks bad:

nyc_airbnb |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = stars, y = price, color = room_type)) + 
  geom_point()

Need to boot strap

airbnb_bootstrap_df = 
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(borough == "Manhattan") |> 
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 1000) |> 
  mutate(
    models = map(strap, \(df) lm(price ~ stars +
                                   room_type, data = df)),
    results = map(models, broom::tidy)
  ) 
airbnb_bootstrap_df |> 
  select(results) |> 
  unnest(results) |> 
  filter(term == "stars") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_density()

Lidar

data("lidar")

lidar |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = logratio)) + 
  geom_point() + 
    stat_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x))

lidar |> 
  modelr::bootstrap(n = 250) |> 
  mutate(
    models = map(strap, \(df) gam(logratio ~ s(range), data = df)),
    results = map(models, \(mod) modelr::add_predictions(data = lidar, model = mod))) |> 
  select(.id, results) |> 
  unnest(results) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = range, y = pred, group = .id)) + 
  geom_path(color = "blue", alpha = .5) + 
  geom_point(data = lidar, aes(y = logratio, group = NULL))
